scope: Audience-switch response ordering and acknowledgement validation. Actual Tool create form, RunResult/LinkCard/BannerCard, useBannerQueue and link builder mounted in React18 StrictMode/JSDOM. Actual ds/DoneBanner and ErrorNotice also mounted, with CSS class names and unused motion helper mocked. Only visual shell, prefill, next wrappers and one-button context are peripheral mocks. No CSS layout or physical image rendering measured. Controlled synthetic creation and banner acknowledgements only, no real browser/network/provider/API/DB or customer records. Demonstrates actual parent create/queue wiring, not production impact, actual generated image pixels or all queue/cancellation behaviors.
